opportunities.name: Tech lead research: HN + GitHub then note
opportunities.description: For a tech project name, look up its top story on Hacker News (search), find its GitHub repo stars and latest release, and save a 'Lead:' note.

Note top story title, points, age
Search the project name in GitHub search
Open the top repo and read stars and last release
Open notes app and add a 'Lead: <name>. HN ...; GitHub ... stars, last release ...' note
